neighbours.label: a hedge that qualifies what kind of thing something is ('of sorts', 'albeit', 'at least not in')
fire: The old barn became a museum of sorts after the farm closed.
I'm finally home, albeit tired and a little sunburned.
It isn't really a car, at least not in the usual sense of the word.
The festival was a reunion of sorts for the old band members.
They found a partnership of a different sort in the end.
She did not accept excuses of any kind from her students.
The plan worked, albeit more slowly than anyone had hoped.
The garden is a refuge of sorts for the tired office workers.
quiet: The old barn became a museum after the farm closed.
I'm finally home, tired and a little sunburned.
It isn't really a car, because it has only three wheels.
The festival was a reunion for the old band members.
They found a new partnership in the end.
She did not accept late excuses from her students.
The plan worked, and faster than anyone had hoped.
The garden is a quiet refuge for the tired office workers.

notes: card: albeit, 'of sorts', 'at least not', 'of a different sort', 'of any kind'; logit promotes sort/kind
